style.styleTitle: Personalised The Snowman Wooden Heart Christmas Decoration by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: This Wooden Heart Decoration will make an excellent addition to any Christmas tree, or will look the part hung around the home. Our The Snowman and the Snowdog Wooden Heart Decoration can be personalised with 1 line of text with up to 30 characters. Please note that all personalisation is case sensitive and will appear as entered. For best results, please avoid entering your message in block capitals. For best results, please avoid entering your text in block capitals as this may make the personalisation difficult to read. Wooden shaped decoration is made from wood with ribbon included. Ideal for Christmas.
